name: Rotor Propeller (Large)
description: Two standard number inputs control the rotor's swashplate, allowing you to affect its pitch and roll. Power received from an engine affects the amount of up and down force that the rotor will generate. The output force of this rotor is decreased when underwater.
shortDescription: A helicopter rotor with controllable pitch and roll.

logicNodes.label: Roll
logicNodes.description: Standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired roll amount.

logicNodes.label: Pitch
logicNodes.description: Standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired pitch amount.

logicNodes.label: Collective
logicNodes.description: Standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired pitch amount.
